description: Interactive change tracking group: a caption from author/datetime plus Tracking / Final / Original toggles over its <ins> / <del> descendants

attributes.name: view
attributes.description: Which text is visible: final (insertions only), original (deletions only); omitted = tracking (both, with announced markers). Observed; works without JS

attributes.name: datetime
attributes.description: ISO date of the change set; rendered in the caption and the controls' name

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Author of the changes; rendered in the caption and the controls' name

events.name: change-set:view
events.description: View changed via the toggles (no source) or the view property (source: 'api'). Bubbles

properties.name: view
properties.description: Get / set the view. Setting the current view is a no-op; unknown values are ignored

childAttributes.name: data-controls
childAttributes.description: Set by the component on the role="group" toggle container

childAttributes.name: data-action
childAttributes.description: Set by the component: the view a toggle selects

childAttributes.name: aria-pressed
childAttributes.description: Set by the component: true on the toggle matching the current view

childAttributes.name: data-change-caption
childAttributes.description: Set by the component on the author/datetime caption
